mintAuthority.summary: USDat is an M0-backed extension with native issuance only on Ethereum; extension wrapping routes through M0 infrastructure while base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway. BNB and Monad USDat deployments are CCIP representations reviewed under Bridge Risk, not additional native issuance chains.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing USDat depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. M0 validator attestations, approved-minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review bound ordinary M issuance; per-Minter capacity remains raiseable by M0 TTG and Registrar governance. No external admin or module surface exists on this immutable gateway.

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: EIP-1967 impl slot=0x45bf08d042a8958f01f8e8319b791e4584550da8 (TransparentUpgradeableProxy). ProxyAdmin (EIP-1967 admin slot)=0x0f38d8a5583f9316084e9c40737244870c565924. SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M and does not create base M supply; extension minting is bounded by available M-backed wrapper flow and base M supply. ProxyAdmin owner=TimelockController 0x23ca665c8a73292fc7ac2cc4493d2ce883bba468 (minDelay=259200s, 3 days); timelock proposer=Gnosis Safe 3/5 (0xb7a9b5f301ef3bad36c2b4964e82931dd7fb989c). SwapFacility capacity follows M supply and its governance/admin path, with no modules detected.

controls.label: USDat proxy admin timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25570046 (2026-07-20): EIP-1967 slots on the USDat proxy 0x23238f20b894f29041f48d88ee91131c395aaa71 read implementation 0x17cac25c6d6bbcb592837fea083a5c8eb4d1e52e and admin 0xcf1072da5f0d127aef99136489bad08bfa3d1a7d; the ProxyAdmin's owner() is TimelockController 0xfd5782e3bff366601da3973ae30c583de4f08a67 with getMinDelay() = 432,000 seconds (5 days).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: MinterGateway confirmed immutable non-proxy (IsProxy=false, both EIP-1967 slots zero). SwapFacility confirmed TransparentUpgradeableProxy; ProxyAdmin=0x0f38d8a5... → TimelockController 0x23ca665c... (3-day minDelay); timelock proposer is Gnosis Safe 3/5. The USDat proxy logic path remains governed by its separate five-day TimelockController. Native USDat issuance is therefore limited to the M0-backed Ethereum extension path; BNB and Monad representations, pools, peer configuration, and token-admin controls are scored under Bridge Risk. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: M0 TTG governance controls base-M capacity while SwapFacility and USDat logic changes pass through enforced three- and five-day timelocks; real-time M0 validator/reserve reconciliation exists without named prudential supervision.
